text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
North Flight, it's North Flight! North 
Flight, cloaked in the spring breeze, has 
vaulted straight to the front lines of the 
Tiara route!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~!? North Flight is overtaking... Harp 
Alpha...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I totally didn't see that coming!? 
This year's Tiara route is getting super 
exciting~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Flight-san! Congrats to ya, yes indeedy—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan, I'm sorry. Can I... lean on 
your shoulder? Just quietly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Flight... Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, doesn't she have 
physical concerns? Hmm... Maybe today's 
run was a miracle—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I saw North Flight pulling back while 
leaning on Yukino Bijin's shoulder, all 
the color instantly drained from my face, 
but...
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're not hurt?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's true! Teacher said so too, 
didn't they?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I seem to have pushed past 
my limits... I'm sorry for making you 
worry.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure everyone watching must have 
been disappointed too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, looking at the audience's 
reaction after North Flight left the 
track... it seems they've become worried 
about her physical condition."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Even so... I'm so glad I got to run today!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I figured out the secret behind the 
brilliance of the Tiara route girls."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
They are dressed in classic, royal-road 
coordinates. Their cuteness is the very 
radiance of a tiara.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I want to wear an outfit like that too... 
One that makes my heart flutter!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"By the time the Shuka Sho comes, I'm sure 
I'll be able to give it even more of my 
all."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"How will someone like me be able to 
shine...? I can't wait to find out!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, North Flight's passion for the 
Shuka Sho grew by yet another notch.
